display_long_description:
As a cybernetic agent dispatched by humanity to counter OMEGA — a super-intelligent AI system plotting to annihilate humankind — your codename is D.A.S.H. (short for Dual Axle Speed Hawk). After you successfully implanted the virus, the emergency protocol in OMEGA’s HQ was activated and your mission is simple: DASH TO SURVIVE!

**Temple Run Meets VR**

A gameplay loop that’s easy to pick up yet insanely addictive. Dash with the dynamic rock-electronic BGM as you ignite dopamine in sleek, cyberpunk-themed neon pipes.


**VR-Optimized Parkour Controls**

Shift dual light wheels for quick direction swift and deploy a laser grappling hook to leap over obstacles. Dodge massive chip traps and use the power-ups wisely to run further.


**Upgrade & Unlock Boosts**

Collect byte coins to unlock power-ups like Magnet, Multiplier, and Shield. Push your limits round after round to beat your highest score.

As humanity’s last hope against the rogue super-AI — can you make it out alive?
